policy_name: Sigmalytic V2 Operator-Control Display Separation Policy

doctrine.operator_control: Operator control is evidence, not a score.
doctrine.production_confirmation: Only D3D may create production operator-control confirmation.
doctrine.d3d_status: D3D remains dry-run and unauthorized unless separately authorized under the D3D execution protocol.
doctrine.d3v_status: D3V preflight rows are dry-run blocked/unmutated unless separately authorized in a future D3D execution protocol.

LEGACY_EVIDENCE_ONLY_NOT_D3D_CONFIRMATIO.ui_label: Legacy Evidence Only — Not D3D Confirmation
LEGACY_EVIDENCE_ONLY_NOT_D3D_CONFIRMATIO.meaning: Legacy operator-control evidence may be shown only as historical or diagnostic evidence. It is not production confirmation.

D3C_SHADOW_READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC.meaning: D3C output is shadow evidence review only. It may support later review but cannot confirm operator control.

D3C2_DIAGNOSTIC_ENRICHMENT_UNCONFIRMED.meaning: D3C.2O/R/S/T evidence is confluence, enrichment, source review, doctrine-leg review, and stealth monitoring only.

D3D_PRODUCTION_CONFIRMATION.meaning: Production confirmation can appear only from the nested production field evidence.operator_control.operator_control_confirmed after separately authorized D3D execution.

D3D_DRY_RUN_UNAUTHORIZED.meaning: D3D has not been authorized to execute and has not mutated campaign evidence.

HVN_ABSORPTION_PROXY_NOT_TRUE_HVN_POC.ui_label: HVN Absorption Proxy — Not True HVN/POC
HVN_ABSORPTION_PROXY_NOT_TRUE_HVN_POC.meaning: HVN_ABSORPTION_PROXY is inferred behavioral-location evidence only. It is not a true HVN, POC, VPOC, or volume-profile source.

D3V_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED_UNMUTATED.meaning: D3V identifies dry-run candidates and block reasons only. It does not authorize or execute D3D.
